prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit input 1 paint_mask_guide.png only. Input 2 design_reference.png is material/detail reference; input 3 icon_x8.png is original colour reference (ignore magenta background).
Produce ONE transparent PNG 1536x2048 (3:4), retaining EXACT input 1 layout, positions, sizes, outlines and all transparent gaps. Three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows 3-4 contain identical five orthographic silhouettes: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. These view names refer to the actual guide; do not rotate or rearrange. Paint existing grey pixels only; do not redraw, enlarge, move or redesign. Keep large empty margins exactly.

Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour of the decorative fantasy prop. Preserve white recurved limbs, black string, white stock, green gems, side lever, green knob, pointed butt. Ivory/bone white surfaces, subdued brass fittings, rich green gems as reference. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow design reference scaled to each view. Unlit base colour ONLY, no lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights or reflections.

Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five silhouettes with FLAT pure category colours only; no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased interior colour blends. #FF0000 every metal (steel iron chain mail gold silver bronze copper brass); #00FF00 leather straps padding hide suede and fur; #0000FF cloth tabards quilting linings cords ribbons and hair; #FFFF00 matte non-metal solids wood bone horn stone parchment paper wax; #000000 gemstone crystal glass pearl enamel or liquid through glass. Ivory/bone body limbs stock lever pointed butt are yellow in masks, metal fittings red, cord blue, green gems/knob black. Each silhouette pixel exactly one category colour, nothing outside silhouettes.

Harmless static decorative prop for cosy fantasy game, texture sheet only. Every gap/opening remains fully transparent. Empty cells column 3 row 2 and row 4 remain completely transparent. No ground, outlines, text, labels, halos, sparkles, aura. Preserve the guide geometry exactly.
CORRECTION PRIORITY: The previous attempt spilled speckled red/yellow paint and halos outside the objects. This is unacceptable. Use the original grey guide alpha and silhouettes as a strict stencil. Every pixel outside those exact silhouettes must have alpha zero, including all inner openings. Crisp clean boundaries, absolutely no spray, noise, glow or fringe. Do not inherit stray pixels from the design reference. Paint rows must be flat unlit colour, not shiny shaded renders. Mask rows strictly flat pure categories. Preserve original guide shapes precisely.
